Taking a diet in which the required nutrients are not in enough quantity or over the
required quantity is called malnutrition. Under nutrition is a consequence of
consuming low amount of essential nutrients while over nutrition means taking too
much nutrients. Severe malnutrition may result in death, heart diseases,
constipation and obesity. The major types of malnutrition are Protein-Energy
Malnutrition (PEM),Mineral Deficiency Diseases (MDD)and Over Intake of
